handoff: Galaxy view: top bar Galaxy button (appears once system 2 is open) or key G; Esc or Close button leaves. Shows explored systems, links, planets with energy/food icons (abundant resource, from art/textures/icons), and the player's routes (green running, amber otherwise). Unreached systems show as a grey circle with '?'. First open shows TUT_GALAXY_INTRO, ICONS, ROUTES in order, once (galaxy_seen saved). Clicking a system closes the view and moves the map camera to that system, so the ROUTES sentence 'Click a system to open it' holds. Tests: pass=226 fail=0. Try: debug menu, buy permit 2, press G.
